decision.interpretation: The exact pinned layer loop can bypass the nominated block groups before Gemma4DecoderLayer.forward, eliminating the counted attention, QKV/O, gate/up/down, normalization, dynamic-FP8, and KV-write path. The conservative trace-backed service bound clears the target after a 12 ms/request incremental overhead envelope. This is an intentionally semantics-changing physical proxy with no accuracy credit.

limitations: No checkpoint was downloaded, no accelerator was claimed, and no provider was contacted.
The result is a source-complete physical bound, not a GPU measurement.
Per-layer prefill projection cost is measured in aggregate and apportioned by exact projection FLOPs; target-verification layer costs are measured medians.
The 33.3125 request-equivalent verification pass count is the conservative lower of two bound counter reconstructions, maximizing the fixed residual and minimizing credited savings.
The 12 ms incremental overhead envelope is analytical and must be replaced by scope-matched measurement if checkpoint recovery is later authorized.

The source-complete proxy is phase-adaptive. Per-request routing across proxy and full-depth graph cohorts remains part of the explicitly deferred quality-recovery runtime and receives no measured credit here.
No semantic, quality, convergence, or deployability claim is made.

physical_accounting.evidence_type: measured scope-matched c32 H200 attention plus measured FP8-linear projection costs; analytical exact layer selection and overhead envelope
physical_accounting.uncredited_removed_work: All skipped layer norms, residual kernels, dynamic-FP8 quantizers, Python dispatch, and KV writes remain inside the fixed residual; no timing credit is taken for them.

quality_recovery_path: Initialize the 60-layer student from the locked teacher; retain every weight and hard-wire the proxy schedule while training only recovery adapters and boundary norms first.

Distill teacher logits and hidden states at the ends of [0,10), [25,35), and [50,60) on 4K-to-32K text, long-context retrieval, and tool-use trajectories, then continue pretraining with the hard prefill and verification schedules.
Only after the fixed schedule recovers, train a request router with full-depth fallback and route-homogeneous batching; do not spend the physical margin as presumed accuracy.
Require scope-matched GPQA-Diamond, TauBench, long-context retrieval, tool-call formatting, multimodal regression, and an exact c32 endpoint measurement before production eligibility.

removed_execution.proof: The exact pinned target trace has four ordered FP8 projections per layer (QKV, O, gate/up, down). Dominating the layer call removes those four launches plus attention and all layer-local consumers; a mask that executes the layer cannot satisfy this source check.
removed_execution.source_boundary: Gemma4TextModel.forward skips before per-layer-input slicing, self.layers[layer_idx] load, and Gemma4DecoderLayer.forward

schedule.heterogeneous_batch_behavior: fail closed before model execution; a later request router must compact requests into separately captured route-homogeneous runtime cohorts
schedule.kv_ownership_invariant: verification_active_layers is a subset of prefill_active_layers; skipped layers are never later read and active layers retain their native layer-indexed KV ownership
schedule.routing_rule: A candidate-only runtime defaults to the proxy route and captures its route-homogeneous c32 graphs. EXTEND/MIXED use prefill_groups; TARGET_VERIFY/DECODE use verification_groups. A separately captured full-depth runtime is the explicit fallback; mixed routes fail closed.

sensitivity.interpretation: At the frozen 12 ms envelope, at most the reported fallback fraction may revert to full depth. At zero fallback, routing, graph, compaction, synchronization, and fragmentation may total at most the reported maximum overhead before the target is lost.
